Definition: from G1537 and G1349; carrying justice out, i.e. a punisher:--a (re-)venger.
BiblicalUsage: An avenger is one who carries justice out, a punisher, and Paul uses the word twice, once for the ruler and once for the Lord. The ruler is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath on him that does evil, and the Lord is the avenger of all who defraud their brother. The word puts a sword in the hand of authority and a warning in the ear of the oppressor.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God has His avengers, both in government and in Himself, and no wrong goes unanswered forever.
